text_block_list.text:
Today marks the final day of the training 
camp with Maruzensky—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Youth really is fleeting, isn't it? 
To think the summer training camp is 
already over...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is no time to get 
sentimental. The Arima Kinen will be here 
in the blink of an eye."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To make this the best race possible, let's 
put everything we gained from training 
camp to good use!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, where are you off to, 
Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: I was thinking of taking the bus...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, where are you off to, 
Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: I was thinking of taking the bus...
I was thinking of taking the bus...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's not right! You're coming with me on 
a fun drive in Tacchan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, on the way back we're gonna tear 
up the road at full throttle too~!!
